meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3 (Greater London Authority). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 2jxq0: resources chosen by the written rules; every row of every sheet or CSV read (CSV over 20 MB streamed and not stored; large xlsx streamed with ExcelJS); a row is kept when it is a zone row (harvest-log.json meta.rules.zone_row): zone OA/LSOA/MSOA/ward code, zone postcode or postcode sector, zone UPRN or TOID, or coordinates in the 3D model box. zone_keys gives the key that matched, row by row. header_rows: the rows above the first data row.
selection_notes: hand rule: kept as tables (5,492 zone permissions: 11.7 MB as GeoJSON points); the permission-level extracts (permissions, non-residential floorspace and bedrooms); the unit-level approvals and completions (3 files, 22,417 zone rows, 40 MB of output) repeat the same permissions unit by unit
